# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Libraries and helpers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(scramv2)
library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(hdf5r)

source('/mnt/raid62/pzz/always_func/read10x_file.R')

setwd('/mnt/raid61/public_data/Curry_etal_2024_CancerCell/')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load per-sample 10x matrices and merge
#    For each sample ID, locate the matching barcode/gene/mtx files in the
#    working directory, build a Seurat object, and tag cells with 'sample'.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define sample IDs
obj_list <-
  lapply(c(
    'OG-02_CO',
    'OG-03_LE',
    'OG-03_CO',
    'GBM-05_LE',
    'GBM-06_CO',
    'GBM-07_CO'
  ), function(x) {
    file <- grep(pattern = x, dir(), value = T)
    obj <-
      Read10X_files(barcode = file[1],
                    gene = file[2],
                    mtx = file[3])
    obj <- CreateSeuratObject(obj)
    obj@meta.data$sample <- x
    obj
  })

dat <- Reduce(merge, obj_list)


## 2. QC filtering
dat[['percent.mt']] <- PercentageFeatureSet(dat, pattern = 'MT-')
dat <-
  dat[, which(
    dat@meta.data$nFeature_RNA > 200 &
      dat@meta.data$nFeature_RNA < 5000 &
      dat@meta.data$percent.mt < 10
  )]



## 3. Standard preprocessing: normalize, HVGs, scaling, PCA

dat <- NormalizeData(dat)
dat <- FindVariableFeatures(dat)
dat <- ScaleData(dat, features = VariableFeatures(dat))

dat <- RunPCA(dat, npcs = 100, features = VariableFeatures(dat))


## 4. Un-integrated clustering on PCA (pre-harmony sanity check)

dat <- FindNeighbors(dat, dims = 1:40, verbose = F)
dat <-
  FindClusters(
    dat,
    resolution = 0.8,
    # dims.use = 1:20,
    dims.use = 1:40,
    print.output = F
  )


dat <- RunUMAP(dat,
               reduction = "pca",
               # dims = 1:20,
               dims = 1:40,
               verbose = F)


library(harmony)



## 5. Harmony integration on 'sample', then re-cluster and re-embed
dat <-
  RunHarmony(
    dat,
    group.by.vars = 'sample',
    dims.use = 1:50,
    plot_convergence = F,
    max.iter.cluster = 100,
    nclust = 100
  )

# Cluster and UMAP on the harmony-corrected embedding
dat <-
  FindNeighbors(dat,
                # dims = 1:20,
                dims = 1:20,
                verbose = F,
                reduction = "harmony",)
dat <-
  FindClusters(
    dat,
    cluster.name = 'harmony_clusters',
    reduction = "harmony",
    resolution = 1.5,
    # dims.use = 1:20,
    dims.use = 1:20,
    print.output = F
  ) %>% RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony",
                # dims = 1:20,
                dims = 1:40,
                reduction.name = "harmony_umap")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Helper: pure-R Seurat -> h5ad writer
#    Replaces SeuratDisk::SaveH5Seurat() + Convert(), which fail on Seurat v5
#    (v5 layers layout vs v3 assays/RNA/data, and hard-deprecated Assay
#    accessors in SeuratObject 5.3).
#
#    Writes a standard AnnData h5ad:
#      X      = <layer> matrix (default: raw counts) as cells x genes CSR
#      obs    = obj@meta.data
#      var    = empty dataframe indexed by gene symbols
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
WriteH5AD <- function(obj, file, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") {
  obj <- tryCatch(JoinLayers(obj), error = function(e) obj)
  m <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = layer)
  stopifnot(inherits(m, "dgCMatrix"))
  stopifnot(is.integer(m@p))  # nnz < 2^31, ensures indptr fits in int32/int64

  cells <- colnames(m)
  genes <- rownames(m)
  meta <- obj@meta.data[cells, , drop = FALSE]
  cols <- colnames(meta)

  # anndata uses '/' as the group separator in HDF5, so column names with '/'
  # cannot be mapped to .obs columns
  if (any(grepl("/", cols, fixed = TRUE)))
    stop("meta.data column names contain '/', cannot write h5ad: ",
         paste(cols[grepl("/", cols, fixed = TRUE)], collapse = ", "))

  if (file.exists(file)) unlink(file)
  message("Writing ", file, " (", length(genes), " genes x ", length(cells),
          " cells, nnz = ", length(m@x), ") ...")

  # Small helpers to attach the encoding attributes anndata expects
  f <- H5File$new(file, "w")
  strdt <- f$create_dataset("__tmp__", "a")$get_type()$copy()
  strdt$set_cset("UTF-8")  # so anndata decodes the strings as str
  f$link_delete("__tmp__")
  scalar <- H5S$new(type = "scalar")
  add_attr <- function(loc, name, val)
    loc$create_attr(name, robj = val, dtype = strdt, space = scalar)
  add_str_arr_attrs <- function(ds) {
    add_attr(ds, "encoding-type",    "string-array")
    add_attr(ds, "encoding-version", "0.2.0")
    invisible(NULL)
  }
  add_array_attrs <- function(ds) {
    add_attr(ds, "encoding-type",    "array")
    add_attr(ds, "encoding-version", "0.2.0")
    invisible(NULL)
  }

  ## X: dgCMatrix is genes x cells (column-sparse), which is exactly the
  ## cells x genes CSR layout used by anndata
  X <- f$create_group("X")
  X$create_dataset("data",    m@x, gzip = 4)  # float64
  X$create_dataset("indices", m@i, gzip = 4)  # int32 (gene indices)
  X$create_dataset("indptr",  m@p, gzip = 4)  # int32
  add_attr(X, "encoding-type",    "csr_matrix")
  add_attr(X, "encoding-version", "0.1.0")
  X$create_attr("shape", robj = c(length(cells), length(genes)),
                dtype = h5types$H5T_NATIVE_INT64)

  ## var: gene-level dataframe (index only, no columns)
  var <- f$create_group("var")
  add_str_arr_attrs(var$create_dataset("_index", genes, gzip = 4))
  add_attr(var, "encoding-type",    "dataframe")
  add_attr(var, "encoding-version", "0.2.0")
  add_attr(var, "_index",           "_index")
  var$create_attr("column-order", robj = character(0), dtype = strdt)

  ## obs: cell-level dataframe from meta.data, typed per column
  obs <- f$create_group("obs")
  for (cn in cols) {
    v <- meta[[cn]]
    if (is.integer(v)) {
      add_array_attrs(obs$create_dataset(cn, v, gzip = 4))            # int32
    } else if (is.numeric(v)) {
      add_array_attrs(obs$create_dataset(cn, as.numeric(v), gzip = 4))# float64
    } else {
      v <- as.character(v)
      v[is.na(v)] <- ""
      add_str_arr_attrs(obs$create_dataset(cn, v, gzip = 4))    # string
    }
  }
  add_str_arr_attrs(obs$create_dataset("_index", cells, gzip = 4))
  add_attr(obs, "encoding-type",    "dataframe")
  add_attr(obs, "encoding-version", "0.2.0")
  add_attr(obs, "_index",           "_index")
  obs$create_attr("column-order", robj = cols, dtype = strdt)

  ## Root attributes (match files written by official anndata)
  add_attr(f, "encoding-type",    "anndata")
  add_attr(f, "encoding-version", "0.1.0")
  f$close_all()
  message("Done.")
  invisible(file)
}


## 7. Export: rebuild a clean object from counts + meta.data, then write h5ad
meta <- dat@meta.data
dat <- JoinLayers(dat)
mtx <- GetAssayData(dat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(mtx, meta.data = meta)

if (!dir.exists("out")) dir.create("out", recursive = TRUE)

# Write the standard h5ad directly (replaces SaveH5Seurat() + Convert())
WriteH5AD(obj, file = "out/adata.h5ad", layer = "counts")

if (!file.exists("seurat_obj.Rds"))
  saveRDS(dat, "seurat_obj.Rds")


## 8. Integrity check of the written h5ad
h5 <- H5File$new("out/adata.h5ad", "r")
stopifnot(
  identical(h5[["X"]]$attr_open("shape")$read(), c(ncol(mtx), nrow(mtx))),
  length(h5[["X/data"]][]) == length(mtx@x),
  identical(h5[["var/_index"]][], rownames(mtx)),
  identical(h5[["obs/_index"]][], colnames(mtx))
)
h5$close_all()

message("\nFinished successfully! Output files:")
message("  - ", normalizePath("out/adata.h5ad"))
message("  - ", normalizePath("seurat_obj.Rds"))
message("\nSubsequent neural network classification (run in a python environment with scanpy/tensorflow):")
message("  cd out && python3 nn_classifier_pretrained.py 041524_glioma ./adata.h5ad --s --normalize_test")
